description: Apply in-range dependency updates to the workspace working tree: upgrades the named packages, or every outdated package (at most 50) when none are named, by re-locking within the constraints already in the manifest (for a uv project `uv lock --upgrade-package`). Precondition: the workspace runs. Side effects: modifies the lockfile in the working tree; it never commits, pushes or opens a PR; run coding_run_checks next and then coding_open_pr. When no packages are named and the gateway reports nothing outdated, every package pyproject.toml declares (dependencies, extras, dependency groups) is re-locked in range instead; the result says which selection was used. Updates beyond a manifest constraint (major bumps) are reported as unchanged, not applied.

packages.description: Package names to upgrade; omit to upgrade every outdated package the gateway detects, or every package pyproject.toml declares when it detects none.

dry_run.description: Plan the upgrade without changing the working tree.

idempotency_key.description: Caller-chosen key; repeating the call with the same key and arguments is safe because every step reads state before writing.
